data.title: 玛露希尔 · 魔物料理的真香现场
data.description: 迷宫营地的锅前，她从「绝对不吃魔物！」的激烈抗拒到小心翼翼地尝一口，再到捧着碗追加第二碗——三个阶段表情变化是这个角色的灵魂三连。

data.camera: three-panel horizontal triptych, medium shot in each panel
data.promptProse: A horizontal three-panel sequence follows Marcille beside the same dungeon camp cooking pot. In the left panel, she leans away from the offered bowl with an emphatic frown and one open palm raised in refusal. In the middle panel, she cautiously tastes one spoonful, green eyes widening in surprise. In the right panel, she holds her empty bowl forward for a second helping, smiling with embarrassed enthusiasm. Each panel shows Marcille once in the same blue travel robe, cream tunic and braided blonde hair. Warm firelight and the repeated pot connect the three moments. Clear panel divisions, no speech balloons or lettering.
